Text: Tuanku Muhriz Ibni Almarhum Tuanku Munawir, has been proclaimed the new Yang Di-Pertuan Besar of Negri Sembilan, following the demise of Tuanku Jaafar ibni Almarhum Tuanku Abdul Rahman.

Ketua Polis Negeri Sembilan Datuk Alzafny Ahmad berkata pihaknya menerima maklumat berhubung pelajar berkenaan yang ditemukan dalam keadaan tidak sedarkan diri di kawasan sebuah sekolah menengah di daerah Seremban pada 10.48 pagi Jumaat (19 Jun).

Two states in Malaysia are heading for elections — Johor in the south will hold polls on Jul 11, while Negeri Sembilan in the west will do so on Aug 1. For Johor, nomination day falls on Jun 27. Following a 14-day campaign period, more than 2.7 million voters will choose their representatives for all 56 seats in the state assembly. In Negeri Sembilan, which has close to 900,000 eligble voters, nominations will take place on Jul 18 for all 36 seats. Coalition partners in the federal-level unity government, Barisan Nasional and Pakatan Harapan, are expected to face off in the state elections. Melissa Goh reports from Seremban, the capital of Negeri Sembilan.
